grammar_focus: 复习 KS20/44/68 need / want + 动名词的用法(收官包·干净课美语化):need + doing 与 want + doing 都表示“需要被……”,用主动的 -ing 形式表达被动的意思(need cleaning = need to be cleaned);对比 need + to do(主语主动去做)
scene: “我觉得窗户不用擦吧,”爸爸看着窗户说。“其实真该擦了,”妈妈笑道,“上面全是灰。”“客人来之前,整间屋子都得收拾一下,”她又说。“地毯得用吸尘器吸一吸,花也该浇水了。”“花园也要拾掇吗?”我哼唧着问。“草是该剪了,”爸爸承认,“不过那个可以缓缓。”我们都同意厨房最该打扫。“我房间不用收拾,”弟弟嘴硬,没人信他。三个小时后,再没什么要做的了。“这屋子需要的可不只是打扫,”爸爸打趣道,“它需要好好歇一歇!”

grammar_card.title: 复习 KS20/44/68 need / want + 动名词
grammar_card.intro: 本课复习一个特别的用法:need 和 want 后面接动名词(-ing)时,用主动的形式表达被动的意思,等于“需要被……”。①need + doing = need to be done(The windows need cleaning = 窗户需要被擦);②want + doing 同义(The grass wants cutting = 草需要被剪);③各种主语、时态都可以(The kitchen needed cleaning;My room doesn't need tidying)。对比:need + to do 则是“主语主动去做某事”(You need to take a rest = 你需要去休息)。

rows: The kitchen needed cleaning. / My room doesn't need tidying.
You need to take a rest.(主语主动去做)

specialRules.rule: 美语“公寓”说 apartment(英式 flat);“垃圾”说 trash(英式 rubbish)。本课已按美语写。
need / want + doing 用主动的 -ing 表被动“需要被……”;need + to do 则是主语主动去做。别把 need cleaning 说成 need to clean(意思会变)。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What did Mom say about the windows?

passage: "I don't think the windows need cleaning," Dad said, looking at them. "Actually, they really need washing," Mom laughed. "They're covered in dust." "The whole house wants tidying before the guests come," she added. "The carpet needs vacuuming, and the plants need watering." "Does the garden need doing too?" I asked with a groan. "The grass wants cutting," Dad admitted, "but that can wait." We all agreed the kitchen needed cleaning the most. "My room doesn't need tidying," my brother claimed. Nobody believed him. After three hours, nothing needed doing anymore. "The house needs more than cleaning," Dad joked. "It needs a rest!"
